map.输入外径与螺距（或TPI），自动匹配标准螺纹规格: Enter the outer diameter and pitch (or TPI) to automatically match the standard thread specification
map.💡 公制螺纹牙型角60°，螺距用mm；英制惠氏螺纹牙型角55°，用TPI；美制U: 💡 Metric threads have a 60° thread angle and use pitch in mm; British Whitworth threads have a 55° thread angle and use TPI; Unified (UN) threads have a 60° thread angle and use TPI.
map.由实测外径/螺距匹配标准螺纹（公制/英制/TPI）。: Match the standard thread (metric / imperial / TPI) from the measured outer diameter and pitch.
map.推算中径 d2、小径 d1、牙型高 H。: Derive the mean diameter d2, minor diameter d1 and thread height H.
map.1/2-20 UNF：TPI=20 → 螺距=25.4/20=1.27 mm；外: 1/2-20 UNF: TPI=20 → pitch=25.4/20=1.27 mm; outer diameter 12.7 mm.
map.中径为何用 0.75H·cos(α/2)？: Why use 0.75H·cos(α/2) for the mean diameter?
map.60° 公制三角螺纹理论牙型，中径 = 大径 − 2×(H/2 在轴向投影)，几: For the theoretical profile of a 60° metric triangular thread, mean diameter = major diameter − 2×(H/2 projected axially), which geometrically yields this expression (H is the theoretical thread height).
map.测外径能唯一确定螺纹？: Can measuring the outer diameter uniquely determine the thread?
map.不能，需同时测螺距（或 TPI）与牙型角；外径相同螺距不同是不同规格。: No, the pitch (or TPI) and thread angle must also be measured; the same outer diameter with a different pitch is a different specification.
